statement: let G := fun (L : ℕ) (x : ℝ) => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range L, Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*(2 : ℝ)^j*x : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I); ∃ L₀ : ℕ, ∀ L : ℕ, L₀ ≤ L → (2 : ℝ)^(-((291/500 : ℝ)*(L : ℝ))) ≤ (MeasureTheory.volume {x : ℝ | x ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 ∧ (93/125 : ℝ)*(L : ℝ) < ‖G L x‖}).toReal

plain_statement.zh: 证明倍频指数和的高值不能过少：从某个 L 起，单位区间中 |Σⱼe(2ʲx)|>0.744L 的点集，其勒贝格测度至少为 2^(−0.582L)。
plain_statement.en: Prove that for every sufficiently large L the set in the unit interval with |sum_{j<L}e(2^j x)|>0.744 L has Lebesgue measure at least 2^(−0.582 L).

brief.zh: 检验只调稀疏集阈值能否完成六个二幂路线。给二进位使用平稳两状态链 P(1|0)=37/500、P(0|1)=3/4。用十六位傅里叶递推和 2π/2¹⁶ 的尾界估计相位均值，用熵率控制典型词数。扩展整个长度 L 的二进柱只损失 O(1/L) 的平均相位裕量。0.582<7/12；若证成，这个阈值无法满足 σ=19/24 时要求的稀疏度，须改进联合素数权或筛常数。
brief.en: Try the stationary binary Markov chain P(1|0)=37/500, P(0|1)=3/4. Bound its Fourier mean with a sixteen-digit recursion and tail 2π/2^16. Use entropy-rate typical words and control the phase variation across the full L-digit cylinders. Since 0.582<7/12, the claimed lower bound obstructs the exceptional-set budget at sigma=19/24; the weighted prime sum may still admit cancellation.
